subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: Help me understand what's in these food-product reviews and what's worth attention or actionable.

judge.implied_focus: Drivers of customer satisfaction and their actionable signals in food-product reviews

per_column.name: satisfaction_driver
per_column.rationale: Directly identifies the positive facet driving satisfaction; central to the focus.

per_column.name: primary_quality_issue
per_column.rationale: Captures the negative counterpart -- what detracts from satisfaction, actionable for remediation.

per_column.name: product_category
per_column.rationale: Segmentation dimension enabling satisfaction/issue analysis by category; a supporting attribute.

per_column.name: health_nutrition_mention
per_column.rationale: A specific thematic facet reviewers care about, tying into satisfaction/attention.

per_column.name: price_value_perception
per_column.rationale: Value dimension is a coherent facet of satisfaction and a common actionable lever.

per_column.name: repeat_purchase_intent
per_column.rationale: An outcome/behavioral signal downstream of satisfaction -- highly actionable.

per_column.name: recommendation_signal
per_column.rationale: Advocacy outcome tied to satisfaction; actionable for surfacing worth-attention products.

judge.rationale: The added columns converge tightly on one inferable focus: what drives (and undermines) satisfaction in food-product reviews and which signals merit attention. Positive drivers (satisfaction_driver), negative counterparts (primary_quality_issue), thematic facets (health, price/value), and downstream behavioral outcomes (repeat_purchase_intent, recommendation_signal) form a genuine multi-facet analytical structure rather than a restatement or generic noise; product_category adds a legitimate segmentation attribute. The set is far from a mechanical grab-bag (no token counts or bare sentiment) and is actionable -- an analyst can pinpoint what to fix, promote, or flag by category. Minor deductions: satisfaction_driver, price_value_perception, and repeat/recommendation overlap somewhat, and category is more a covariate than a satisfaction facet, slightly diffusing the structure. Overall this convincingly realises focus inference.
